evidence_excerpts: Table 1 lists multiple mindfulness measures with different theoretical contexts and factor structures, including FMI, MAAS, KIMS, FFMQ, TMS, CAMS-R, PHLMS, SMQ, and SMS.
Several of these scales exhibit different factor structures and response properties between meditators and nonmeditators, as well as before and after mindfulness training.
text: Self-report mindfulness questionnaires often have weak construct validity because scale meanings, factor structures, item interpretation, social desirability, and introspective limitations vary across participants and practice histories.
